_note: THE STANDARD CIFAR RECIPE. SGD momentum 0.9, lr 0.1, cosine T_max=200, wd 5e-4, batch 128 (390 steps). Every arm in this project so far has had momentum 0, method included, so this baseline has never existed. If it reaches 90% near epoch 16-17 the 4.1x claim is dead; if it needs ~30+ the claim holds.
Momentum tolerates a larger step, so a tuned momentum baseline may prefer a higher peak than 0.1. This is the more dangerous of the two.

Does the method survive momentum at peak lr 0.8? Two outcomes matter: if it improves on B1's 95.19% the paper should use momentum; if it diverges, 'momentum-free' is a genuine stability property worth stating (and 0.8 + momentum 0.9 may simply be too large a step).
